The pies

What are you craving?

The whole printed menu, sorted the way the case is. Slices are $6, à la mode $7. Whole pies $33, specialty $36 — order a day ahead.

Lush pies

Whole $33 · the pie that named her

A lush is her invention — a cookie-crumb crust, a cream-cheese layer, a pudding layer, whipped cream on top. The Butterscotch Lush is the one a customer tasted and called her a pie goddess.

Our story

Somebody tasted the Butterscotch Lush and said, “You're a pie goddess.”

Suzie Sidhu grew up in Enumclaw and learned to bake at her mother's place, The Sweet Shoppe in Buckley. A customer tried her Butterscotch Lush and gave her the name. It stuck through years at Cafe Panini — ten to fifteen pies a day, a hundred slices — and went on the sign when she opened this shop on Griffin Ave.

In 2009 she entered all eight professional categories at the National Pie Championships and came home with first place for her peanut butter pie. Her business card said “stressed spelled backwards is desserts.”

Suzie passed in 2019. The ovens didn't stop. [PLACEHOLDER — ask who carries it on today, and how they'd like to be named] Same recipes, same case, same smell when the door opens.

Scratch-baked pies and dinners to go in downtown Enumclaw. By the slice, à la mode, or whole with a day's notice.
